Personally, this classic atmosphere was much better than any other local style bar.

Terrible service
Nov 2020 • Friends
I had a terrible experience tonight (18/11/2020) at Pharaoh bar due to the lack of management skill from the bar's manager. 

I booked a table for 12 people 1 day in advanced for lady night at Pharaoh bar for a friend's birthday. In the afternoon, the manager called and told me they reserved a large table in the middle of the room for us as our group's number of people was big. So sitting in the middle would be more comfortable than sitting by the window. I agreed and thanked for his thoughtfulness. 

When I arrived, the table in the middle of the room was taken by a group of Korean men. The waiters set us ul at a small table by the window without explaining anything. Of course there wasn't enough room for everyone. But we chose to enjoy our night without complaining. 

There was a slight coincident happened when our group wanted to stand up and take a photo by the bar's wall. It was near the Korean group's table, however it had no contact whatsoever to their table. They held up their phone asking to take our photos, and also asked the waiters to tell us that they would want to take a photo with us after. We politely refused. 1 man from the table decided to yell and pointed at us to get out of their sight, even though we stood 1 meter away from them and had no contact with them at all. We were all in shock of how rude he was. 

However, the bar manager agreed to the yelling guy and told us to move to another spot. We politely moved. Then the manager came to my table and asked me to come talk to him, saying he did that because didn't want any trouble for us, and he wanted to keep us safe (?!!)
That sounds like a horrible explaination to me and I'm til now not sure what kind of unsafeness we were about to get ourselves into as we ladies having fun and taking photos of ourselves at lady nights in a bar like this.

And also, the reason we had to stood up to take photos was because the manager squeezed us into a smaller table than he had promised. 

At last, when the bill came out, there was 1 extra drink that we didn't order added falsely. 

The lady night which was supppsed to be fun and all turned out to be such a huge dissapointment. And there wasn't 1 single apoligize throughout the whole night. For a reputable place like this, I expect better service and will make sure not to recommend this place to anyone so that noone would have to endure such a terrible experience.

Feeling insulted by the customer service.
Jun 2020 • Friends
Please improve Customer service. I was hushed away by one of the managers, mr. Son Le, while talking with him about how we can plan our friend's proposal. We had a table there and were customers of the restaurant, and yet i was not given the treatment as such. I felt insulted by that act and it greatly damages my impression of this place. I don't recommend this place to anyone who is planning for a special event. The service lacks professionalism that should be seen at a 4-Star restaurant/bar. We were planning a wedding proposal, and we had talked to the manager beforehand. Nevertheless, there was no welcoming gestures from the bar. No flowers, no candles, no music, not even a complimentary drink for the couple's special day. We felt that we didn't receive the service we expected from such a high-class bar/restaurant. Collectively as a group, we feel uncomfortable with recommending this to anyone.
